title: quercus faginea subvar. pedunculata
intro: Quercus faginea subvar. pedunculata, commonly known as the Pedunculate Portuguese Oak, is a subspecies of tree within the Quercus faginea species, known for its distinctive acorns and robust growth. The health benefits of Pedunculate Portuguese Oak include its antioxidant properties, which help protect against cell damage and inflammation, as well as its potential to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial activities, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions, such as arthritis, respiratory infections, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Pedunculate Portuguese Oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
